M1 Tests

--------------------------------
File Loading
--------------------------------
- Valid records, blank lines, comment lines, and records with too few or too many fields.
- A missing file
- Duplicate department names that differ only by capitalization.
- Duplicate and reversed connections to departments, and unknown department parents.

Test #:         1a
Description:    Valid Records
Input:          departments.txt as provided by default.
Expected:       "CREATED ROOT NODE: University, WITH PARENT: NONE, CREATED NODE: College of Engineering, WITH PARENT: University, etc."
Actual:         "CREATED ROOT NODE: University, WITH PARENT: NONE, CREATED NODE: College of Engineering, WITH PARENT: University, etc."
Pass/Fail:      PASS

Test #:         1b
Description:    Blank Lines, Comment Lines
Input:          departments.txt but with an extra blank line between the existing entries and the existing comment line.
Expected:       Correctly ignored, output is the same as Test 1a
Actual:         Correctly ignored, output is the same as Test 1a
Pass/Fail:      PASS

Test #:         1c
Description:    Records with too few or too many fields
Input:          departments.txt but with added fields that have incorrect formats
Expected:       "Warning: Line 3 in file data/departments.txt has incorrect format."
Actual:         "Warning: Line 3 in file data/departments.txt has incorrect format."
Pass/Fail:      PASS

Test #:         2
Description:    Missing File
Input:          department.txt is missing
Expected:       "Error: Could not open file data/departments.txt | Could not load |data/departments.txt|. Make sure it's in the 'data' folder."
Actual:         "Error: Could not open file data/departments.txt | Could not load |data/departments.txt|. Make sure it's in the 'data' folder."
Pass/Fail:      PASS

Test #:         3
Description:    Duplicate department names that differ only by capitalization
Input:          department.txt with duplicates with differing capitalization
Expected:       "Warning: You cannot create a Node that already exists."
Actual:         Node got created anyway with the differences in capitalization intact as input stated.
Pass/Fail:      FAIL

Test #:         4
Description:    Both fields are the same input (e.g. "University|University")
Input:          department.txt with "University|University" added
Expected:       "Warning: A Node cannot be it's own parent."
Actual:         "Warning: A Node cannot be it's own parent."
Pass/Fail:      PASS
